component.name: Azure Virtual Desktop
component.summary: Native Linux client for Azure Virtual Desktop with Smart Card redirection

description.p: Azure Virtual Desktop for Linux is a modern, native GTK 4 and Libadwaita client designed for accessing Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) workspaces with first-class Smart Card (DoD CAC / PIV) redirection support.

ul.li: Full support for Azure US DoD, Azure US Government (GCC High), and Azure Commercial.
Native Smart Card / DoD CAC hardware token redirection via FreeRDP 3.
Seamless Entra ID Certificate-Based Authentication (CBA) via host PKCS#11.
Automatic workspace resource detection and direct FreeRDP session launching.
Hardware-accelerated graphics rendering and audio redirection.
DoD sovereign cloud (rdweb.wvd.azure.us) and DISA tenants.
